publisher.description: the person or organisation that publishes the newsletter, as the publisher names itself

homepage.description: the publisher's own page for the newsletter

feed_url.description: the public RSS or Atom feed the publisher advertises; the job matches this address to its source entry

cadence.description: how often the publisher says it publishes; absent when the publisher does not say

language.description: language of the issues, as an ISO 639-1 code

series.description: the named series the newsletter publishes under a title prefix or a numbered title pattern; absent when it has none. An issue whose title starts with a `title_prefix`, or matches the `title_pattern`, belongs to that series

name.description: the series' name as the publisher writes it, e.g. AINews

title_prefix.description: the exact text the series' issue titles start with, e.g. [AINews]

title_pattern.description: literal title text with one `{number}` placeholder for the issue number, matched from the start of the title, e.g. Latest open artifacts (#{number}):; no other pattern syntax
